title: Guap
description: Survival suit for old age, seeking light and exploration, pure gaming experience
body:
## **👋Welcome To Guap！**
You can check out **www.guapfun.top**
_Offline players can enter the server_
We are a very niche server. If you want to join us, you can search for the group chat on QQ: 1059933654
The server is using the DOM Territory plugin. If a bug occurs, please report it to the administrator.
You can play with more enchantments than the original Minecraft on the server, and also have skill plugins.
### Tips:
Starting from 2026, the server will stop the top-up mode, and any cash transactions are prohibited. If you want to support the server, please private message the administrator Hakimi_Meow.
Most of the server is in pure Chinese. If you want a better experience, you can install a real-time translation mod like AI Translate All in One.
This is a Chinese server. If you are on an external network, you may not be able to connect to the server. You can use a VPN, and the server will not block you.
